label: 60 · Ref Across Steps
description: A ref with stepIndex is a BACK-EDGE: a later step shows an earlier step's exact rendered pixels, no re-render. Back-edges only (forward refs are an error), plus the handoff idiom where the producer self-stamps {stepIndex, flattenedStableKey} for the consumer to spread.

word.label: Word
word.description: Rendered ONCE in the producer step. The consumer step mirrors those pixels back instead of drawing them again.

keepProducer.label: Keep producer output
keepProducer.description: Ship the producer step as a file too. Off, it is intermediate: it renders (the ref needs it) but never reaches the deliverable.
